meta.title: MEASURED planted area + registered farm households by province (DOAE registry)
meta.provenance: MEASURED — DOAE farmer registration. Sugarcane absent (OCSB, not DOAE). This is a REGISTRY, not a full census: growers who register elsewhere (rubber with RAOT, palm via their mill) are undercounted, so absolute area is not comparable across crops — the reliable read is the belt RANKING within one crop.
